messages:
Tanner: Short postmortem follow-up: we need concrete owners for the remaining KV-cache remediation steps (profiling root causes, small-alloc retention, GC strategy, and a short emergency play). Please claim items you can deliver this sprint.

Lina: I can take the small-alloc retention analysis. Plan: run jemalloc stats + allocation timeline across churned prefixes, produce a 1-pager with reproducible steps. ETA: Thu EOD.

Vik: I'll own GC strategy experiments. Hypothesis: background compaction with size-class-aware passes will reduce fragmentation without adding tail latency. Will run quick ABs in staging. ETA: Tue.

Grace: I'll handle the emergency playbook and a short runbook for ops: automatic node drain on sustained mem > 90% and an emergency flag to prefer read-only mode. Draft playbook by Mon.

Maya: I'll add observability: `ghost_alloc_rate`, `per_prefix_retained_bytes`, and an event when a node enters emergency-mode. Dashboards + alerts by Wed.

Tanner: Good. Lina, include the exact jemalloc commands and a tiny repro harness. Vik, keep the config matrix so we can replay results. Grace, add comms templates for Support. Maya, include query samples for the dashboard.

Lina: Jemalloc sampling commands I'll include: `MALLOC_CONF=prof:true,prof_active:false,lg_prof_sample:19 ./kvnode` then toggle prof_active via signal and collect `jeprof --text`. I'll add a shell wrapper.

Vik: Draft GC flags to test: `--kv-compact-window=45s --compact-mode=background --compact-frag-threshold=0.28`. Will measure p95/p99 delta and compaction CPU.

Grace: Emergency playbook: step 1) detect sustained mem >90% for 90s, 2) mark node read-only, 3) drain traffic, 4) open incident w/ heap dump link. I'll add rollback steps.

Maya: Alert thresholds proposal: warning at ghost_alloc_rate > 3/min, critical at ghost_alloc_rate > 10/min OR emergency-mode entered. Will add dashboards and an alert runbook link.

CI-Bot: Reminder: add owners + ETAs to postmortem board card and link any PRs or runbooks.

Tanner: Recap (locked owners): Lina - alloc retention analysis (Thu EOD); Vik - GC experiments (Tue); Grace - emergency playbook (Mon); Maya - observability + alerts (Wed). I'll create the board card and a 25m sync on Friday to review artifacts.

Lina: Uploading repro harness and initial jemalloc profiles to the postmortem doc.

Vik: Starting staging runs now against the canary workload.

Grace: Draft playbook posted in the board card, tagging Support for review.

Maya: Dashboards PR created: `obs/kv-retention`  will link alerts after review.

Tanner: Thanks all. If you need to shift ETAs, update the card and ping me. Sync invite incoming.
